carry-forwards.reason:
The waiver was voided by commit 9c19f97a ('document and folder cleanup'), which MOVED patches/1100_hi70_direct_op_evidence.py to patches/1100_hi70_direct_op_evidence/patch.py and, in the same commit, updated one comment line inside the emitted payload that names the file's own path -- while recording the PRE-move hash here. The entire diff is:
  -    // See patches/1100_hi70_direct_op_evidence.py for the full rationale.
  +    // See patches/1100_hi70_direct_op_evidence/patch.py for the full rationale.
6 bytes, a C++ line comment, in a self-referential path. No anchor, no edit, no emitted code changed. The waiver has been void since 2026-08-28 but was unenforced because the production admission gate stays dormant until the repo holds its first non-grandfathered eligible record. RD73's promotion (2026-09-05) supplied that record, arming the gate and blocking ALL production builds on this one comment.
carry-forwards.scope: This carry-forward covers EXACTLY this digest transition for this patch. It is not a precedent that comments are generally irrelevant: the emitted source did change, so an applied-effect identity would still invalidate it. The general fix is effect_digest_v1 = H(control_tree, subject_tree), which makes evidence survive patch.py refactors that materialize the same tested source transition. Until that lands, any further digest change to this patch requires real evidence.
